1. We need a 1 m 80 cm cloth to make a shirt for a 10-year old child. How much cloth will be needed to make shirts for 20 such children? 20 × 1 m 80 cm = 20 × 1 m and 20 × 80 cm = 20 m + 1600 cm = 20 m + 16 m = 36 m. Multiplying and Dividing Lengths Break the quantity into m and cm Break the quantity into m and cm and multiply. You can also convert and multiply.
